Which one of the following criticisms of the Dickey-Fuller/Engle-Granger approach to dealing with cointegrated variables is overcome by the Engle-Yoo (EY) procedure?
Option A: In the context of small samples, Dickey Fuller tests are prone to conclude that there is a unit root in a series when there is not
Option B: The Engle-Granger (EG) approach can only detect up to one cointegrating relationship even though there could be more than one
Option C: The variables are treated asymmetrically in the cointegrating tests
Option D: It is not possible to perform tests about the cointegrating relationship
